title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
slides: Can Anthropic prove an AI is really its model?
It's building identity verification for AI models
But the system may not catch fine-tuned copies
Buyers could demand proof before deploying models
Ask your vendor: can you verify model identity?
thread_text:
1. Can You Prove It?

Anthropic is building identity verification for AI models. The goal: prove a model is really yours, not a copy.

2. The Copycat Problem

Fine-tuned copies can slip past the system. Verification works on originals, but tweaked versions may not be caught.

3. Buyers Want Proof

Before deploying a model, buyers could demand identity verification. Vendors who can't prove it may lose deals.

4. A New Standard

Model identity checks could become a procurement requirement. Companies will ask for proof before signing contracts.

5. Ask Your Vendor

Next time you evaluate an AI model, ask: can you verify its identity? If they can't answer, that's your answer.
